Capacity (MW).note:
The value stays 131.6 MW.

Capacity:
- Open the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources preliminary determination at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1212654. The project summary says seven natural gas-fired engines 'each rated at 18.8 MW gross power output' and 'a total nominal electric output of 132 megawatts'.
- The draft permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1219947 lists 'Seven (7) 18,817 kW Nominal Site Rating Natural Gas-fired RICE'. Seven times 18.817 is 131.7 MW.
- The Public Service Commission final decision at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=552621 rounds this to 'approximately 128 MW', so it is a different figure. We record the equipment nameplate, which is about 131.6 MW.

qa.question: Are Sierra Club units 5 to 11 the seven Paris RICE engines in docket 6630-CE-316?
qa.finding: The air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1212654 authorizes seven 18.8 MW natural gas engines at Paris, 'Seven (7) natural gas-fired RICE each rated at 18.8 MW gross power output'. That matches seven units of about 19 MW. GEM holds them as one unit of 131.6 MW.
qa.recommendation: Treat the Sierra Club 'Paris Internal Combustion Project' units 5 to 11 as this plant's seven engines and keep GEM's single unit of 131.6 MW. Add no new units.
qa.note: The Public Service Commission docket 6630-CE-316 final decision at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=552621 describes seven engines 'generating up to 128 MW Total'. The Sierra Club list itself was not cited, since it is only a lead.

qa.question: Should capacity stay at 131.6 MW when WEC and the PSC say 128 MW?
qa.finding: The WEC Energy Group investor update from September 2026 at https://www.wpr.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/09-2026-September-Final-1.pdf lists Paris RICE generation at 128 MW in the table headed Thermal Generation and Other Projects. The Public Service Commission final decision at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=552621 says 'approximately 128 MW'. The air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1212654 says seven engines of 18.8 MW and 'a total nominal electric output of 132 megawatts'.
qa.recommendation: Leave capacity at 131.6 MW, because the permit gives the installed nameplate per engine. Tick the IRP box only if the reviewer counts investor updates as a plan.
qa.note: This finding comes from the investor update, so it is a plan-sourced value with irp true. It differs from GEM only by rounding and the permit's gross rating.
